name: Miss Outsider
original_name: คุณหญิงนอกทำเนียบ
overview: Sagee is a poor beautiful girl who loves her mother, Juk, with all her heart. Sagee was looked down upon by people around which made her want to have a better life. On her high school graduation day, Sagee and her best friend, Gamkaew, were chosen to perform a show which was absolutely impressive. Gamkaew is the daughter of minister Parjit and Madam Arunvatee. Madam Arunvatee finds something inside this poor beautiful girl Sagee. Madam Arunvatee offers an opportunity to Sagee and teaches her how to behave as a Madam. She wants her to be the new wife of her husband after she dies. Cheewin, son of the minister and Madam Arunvatee and Gamkaew’s older brother, saw Sagee at the event. It's love at first sight. Supun is another man who falls in love with Sagee and tries to warn her about her new life. Finally, Sagee becomes a full Madam but the higher she goes, the lonelier she gets. In her heart she just wants someone who truly loves her without fame and estate.
